name: the name of the template
author: the author’s name
authorIRI: an IRI to identify the author, such as an Orcid identifier
namespaceIRI: the IRI of the namespace where the template is declared
version: the template’s version; combined with Namespace IRI and Name, it forms a unique IRI for the template
wasRevisionOf: the IRI of the previous version of the template
purpose: a situation the template describes and what its description aims to achieve
context: the circumstances in which the situation may occur and why it is important to model that situation
solution: the provenance template, provided graphically and in a PROV-serialisable format
design_considerations: the factors that influenced the design of the template
automatically_derived_by: the template task file used to automatically derive the template, if any
influenced_by: a statement describing how the template was constructed, if it was manually composed
bindings_schemas: the bindings schemas associated with this template
comments: any additional comments; note that variable descriptions can be left to the bindings schemas
